name: listServers
description: Enumerate the natively-configured (stdio) MCP servers. Reads the persisted `nexus.mcp_server_configs` prefs and returns only each server's opaque id + transport kind — never its command / args / env (which may carry secrets). The JS MCPPool calls this at init to discover which native servers exist, then `connect`s each. Output: { servers: array<{ id: string, transport: "stdio" }> }.
